'''Kaniwa''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can either be [[milling|milled]] into [[flour|kaniwa flour]] or [[brewing|brewed]] into [[alcohol|kaniwa beer]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] kaniwa for its ''beer''.
